privacy_header_title: We Understand the Significance of Personal Privacy
privacy_sec1_title: 1. What Personal Info Do We Collect?
privacy_sec1_content: When you create account, we collect name, username, avatar, bound game character UID & verified email as needed.
privacy_sec2_title: 2. How Do We Use This Info?
privacy_sec2_content: Info is strictly limited to profile setup, match scheduling, anti-cheat verification, and community health rules enforcement.
privacy_sec3_content: We follow high industry encryption communication & strict storage standards to protect core sensitive info.
privacy_sec4_content: Utilizes device local storage tech to cache login state validity and record custom preference habits.
privacy_sec5_content: Integrated with Google secure auth and compliant ad networks, operating under independent monitored policies.
privacy_sec6_content: You have statutory right to review, correct or download personal data via 'Export & Download Personal Data'.
privacy_sec7_content: We do not provide registration/tracking to under-13 group, nor intentionally harvest minor personal info.
privacy_sec8_content: Policy may be tweaked with regulations; major changes will be announced via prominent homepage banner.
terms_header_desc: Please read through all terms of this agreement carefully before browsing or participating in Gamers ID features.
terms_sec1_item1: • Downloading/installing or using software in any way indicates full agreement and commitment to this agreement.
terms_sec1_item2: • If you hold reservations or objections to any detail, stop visiting and uninstall client immediately.
terms_sec1_item3: • All registered participants bear equal compliance and disciplinary obligations.
terms_sec2_item1: • Safeguarding account credentials and access permissions is account owner's safety obligation.
terms_sec2_item2: • Natural persons are only licensed to register and own one official verified Gamer ID.
terms_sec2_item3: • Forging identity materials or impersonating others will directly result in permanent ban.
terms_sec2_item4: • Vulgar or insulting terms in profile bio or nickname are strictly prohibited.
terms_sec3_item1: • Respect opponents in all duels and interactions, upholding healthy sportsmanship.
terms_sec3_item2: • Intentional personal attacks, hate speech, or cyberbullying will face suspension.
terms_sec3_item3: • Posting spam referral links, phishing sites, or fraudulent info in public/private chat is banned.
terms_sec3_item4: • Submitting fake match screenshots, forged win proofs or claiming unearned points are violations.
terms_sec3_item5: • Recalcitrant or severe offenders will face device-level permanent bans.
terms_sec3_item6: • Final arbitration decisions made by admins based on objective evidence are final.
terms_sec4_item1: • Players must strictly follow rules established for custom match rooms.
terms_sec4_item2: • Using hacks, plugins or scripts to tamper with client during duels results in disqualification.
terms_sec4_item3: • Reward coins are issued only to compliant players verified as winners.
terms_sec4_item4: • In case of match disputes, tournament staff will review both settlement screenshots for arbitration.
terms_sec5_item1: • G-Coins are ecosystem virtual tokens for internal feature interaction only, lacking fiat attributes.
terms_sec5_item2: • Exploiting system bugs or loopholes to farm/illegally possess virtual tokens is strictly prohibited.
terms_sec5_item3: • Check-in perks, task rewards, and referral commissions are bound by strict risk rules.
terms_sec5_item4: • Management reserves right to dynamically balance token economy within legal bounds.
terms_sec6_item1: • You are responsible for posts, game recordings, and screenshots you publish publicly.
terms_sec6_item2: • Infringing upload or piracy of unauthorized copyrighted audio-visual materials is banned.
terms_sec6_item3: • Spreading illegal, pornographic or violent content leads to ban and data handed to judiciary.
terms_sec6_item4: • Admins have right to remove suspected violation content items without prior notice.
terms_sec7_item1: • Personal data collection and custody are governed entirely by Privacy Policy.
terms_sec7_item2: • We solemnly promise never to sell, rent or privately transfer players' core privacy records.
terms_sec7_item3: • Users can request full deletion of personal info anytime via official channels.
terms_sec7_item4: • Analytics parameters collected are used solely for app performance tuning and bug prevention.
terms_sec8_item1: • Commercial ad content presented is supplied by third-party regular ad networks.
terms_sec8_item2: • Management team is exempt from legal liability for security/fulfillment of third-party external links.
terms_sec8_item3: • Full playback completion is required to trigger corresponding G-Coins reward credit.
terms_sec8_item4: • Using ad blockers or simulation scripts to bypass ad logic for arbitrage is prohibited.
terms_sec9_item1: • Accounts with severe disciplinary violations may be forcibly frozen without warning.
terms_sec9_item2: • Permanently banned accounts forfeit all bound virtual assets and privileges.
terms_sec9_item3: • If dissatisfied, penalized parties can submit one written review defense via support email.
terms_sec10_item1: • Services are provided 'as is' under current tech conditions without exclusive express guarantees.
terms_sec10_item2: • Platform is not responsible for disconnects or losses caused by player network dropouts/compatibility.
terms_sec10_item3: • Team will strive to repair outages caused by force majeure or backbone network cuts without extra compensation.
terms_sec11_item1: • Management has right to amend agreement appropriately per compliance needs.
terms_sec11_item2: • Major clause changes will be notified via push or in-app popups in advance.
terms_sec11_item3: • Continued software use after new agreement takes effect constitutes agreement to revised terms.
